summary: Starfield Script Extender (SFSE) plugin providing direct HOTAS/HOSAS ship flight control via native DirectInput HID polling. Features an in-game ImGui binding wizard, per-axis inversion and sensitivity, 22 configurable ship action button bindings, digital axis emulation, and live config reload — no vJoy or Joystick Gremlin required.

src.purpose: All plugin C++ source files: the main entry point, low-level memory hooks, setting beacon, DirectInput controller thread, ImGui binding wizard, ship output, ControlMap reader, D3D12 UI hook, and runtime paths/logging.

include.purpose: All plugin C++ headers: class declarations and struct definitions, the precompiled header (PCH.h), the vendored SFSE ABI (SFSEInterface.h), DirectInput/KBM utilities, and device manager.

config.purpose: Standalone AbsoluteHOTAS.ini configuration file shipped with the plugin.

tests.purpose: Standalone unit test for ControlMapReader (built via the opt-in control_map_reader_test xmake target) plus captured binary fixtures.

subdirectories.fixtures: Real captured ControlMap binary files used by the test (control_map_default.bin, control_map_configurator.bin).

docs.purpose: Technical documentation containing flight control cluster memory maps, hardware specifications, and output scancode reference charts.

subdirectories.reference: Markdown reference files documenting key output scancodes, ini options, and control cluster architecture.

src/Main.cpp.purpose: Defines SFSEPluginLoad which initializes log paths, sets up a vectored exception handler for crash monitoring, plants the Setting beacon, installs the low-level hooks, initializes the controller thread, and hooks D3D12 via UIHook.

src/ThrottleHook.cpp.purpose: Handles AOB signature scanning inside the game's .text section, allocates 2GB-near memory trampolines, hooks the critical flight writer path, registers manual camera/rotational gates, and provides safe override logic for ship roll, pitch, yaw, and throttle (via per-offset silence gates).

src/ThrottleController.cpp.purpose: Manages the execution thread of the DirectInput controller, normalizes and deadzones axis inputs, handles ship button bindings, and delegates processing to specific subsystems.

src/SignalHunter.cpp.purpose: Runs the 'Signal Hunter' algorithm to locate the dynamic control cluster (leveraging the fThrottleAtEngineStart beacon), performs throttle injection, manages reverse thrust/boost zones, and handles turn assist silence gates.

src/ShipOutput.cpp.purpose: Handles ref-counted holding state for specific ship buttons/actions, resolving overlapping commands and translating them to KBM injects.

src/AimController.cpp.purpose: Drives the source-object reticle/cursor via DirectInput axes or buttons independently from steering, including HOSAM alignment assist logic.

src/SettingBeacon.cpp.purpose: Scans the game module's .data and .rdata memory sections to locate the fThrottleAtEngineStart and fRollDeadzone settings, planting a signpost value (0.0314f) and disabling the native roll deadzone.

src/BindingWizard.cpp.purpose: Implements the interactive in-game overlay wizard allowing users to dynamically bind controller axes and buttons, calibrate deadzones, and configure sensitivities.

src/WizardCapture.cpp.purpose: Handles live input capture for physical joystick buttons/axes within the ImGui wizard UI.

src/WizardConfig.cpp.purpose: Serializes and saves custom controller configurations directly to AbsoluteHOTAS.ini from the ImGui wizard.

config/AbsoluteHOTAS.ini.purpose: Provides user-definable mapping settings for flight axes, gain parameters, physical button assignments, custom scancodes, and idle deadzones.

src/DeviceManager.cpp.purpose: Manages low-level DirectInput 8 device enumeration, initialization, and capability polling for connected HOTAS/HOSAS controllers.

src/UIHook.cpp.purpose: Hooks the game's D3D12 Present and ResizeBuffers calls using MinHook to inject and render the ImGui controller configuration overlay.

src/RuntimePaths.cpp.purpose: Resolves documents, SFSE plugins, and logs paths, handling thread-safe append operations to the plugin log file.

flight_control_cluster.base_register: RDI (captured from execution stream of the writer block)
flight_control_cluster.base_pointer_source: R13 (upstream source object for processed intent)

memory_lanes.cluster_base + 0x58: Signed Roll / Lateral Output Lane (Float, -1.0 to +1.0)
memory_lanes.cluster_base + 0x68: Signed Throttle Target / Reverse-Capable Throttle Lane (Float, 0.0 to 1.0 or signed)

validation_heuristics.corroboration: Ensuring the read float values are finite, reasonable, and adjacent lanes scale together under isolated inputs.

zero_config_discovery.setting_beacon: The plugin dynamically plants a float beacon (0.0314f) into the fThrottleAtEngineStart setting in memory. This eliminates the need for StarfieldCustom.ini edits and resolves addresses dynamically without Address Library.

pilot_turn_assist.silence_gate_override: Per-offset silence gates independently silence +0x68 (input target) and +0x6C (effective throttle). When pilot turn assist is active, the +0x6C gate is lifted, allowing the game's native rotation-deceleration assist to function, while the hardware input preserves target throttle on +0x68.

shipping_paradigm.standalone_mode: The mod compiles into AbsoluteHOTAS.dll and AbsoluteHOTAS.ini. Legacy scripting components (Papyrus, .esm, quest seat-trackers) have been removed from the release path, ensuring direct and standalone flight controller execution on DLL load.

how_to_add_new_ship_action.ini_config: Add new i<Action>Button under [ShipButtons] and s<Action>Output under [ShipButtonOutputs] in config/AbsoluteHOTAS.ini.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.controller_declaration: Update ThrottleController::Config struct in include/ThrottleController.h to include the new bindings.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.config_parsing: Add standard BindingDef in src/ThrottleController.cpp inside LoadShipButtonBindings to map the actionId, INI key, and output string key.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.default_output: Register default action scancode in DefaultShipOutputForAction inside src/ThrottleController.cpp.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.state_update: Update state evaluation in UpdateShipButtonBindings to check physical press and trigger SetOutputHeld/PulseOutput.

how_to_adjust_axis_normalization_or_reve.variables: Change configuration mappings in LoadConfig (detents, idle plateaus, reverse threshold) and adjust matching variables in include/ThrottleController.h.

how_to_update_writer_block_hooks_for_gam.signature_update: Verify assembly signature in InstallRotationalGates and raw Pattern structs in src/ThrottleHook.cpp.
how_to_update_writer_block_hooks_for_gam.call_rva_update: Adjust version constant bounds and target displacement search bounds (e.g. 0x12B0000 to 0x12C0000 range check in ThrottleHook.cpp line 817).
